system.$description: The platform's own UI font, never a web font: the bundle makes no network requests. Apple HIG, Typography: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/typography

size.$description: The macOS type scale in points (HIG Typography, macOS built-in text styles). 13 is body; 10 is the minimum.

medium.$description: SF Pro's medium cut; other system fonts round to their nearest weight.

space.$description: The 4 px spacing grid (HIG Layout: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/layout). The step is the multiple of 4 px.

control.$description: Height of a regular control on desktop (HIG Buttons: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons). phone.json raises it to the 44 px touch target.

compact.$description: Compact icon rail: a 32 px row plus 8 px padding on each side. HIG Sidebars: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/sidebars

narrow.$description: Sidebar narrow width. At a 1280 px canvas the defaults leave over 700 px for focused work before dividers. Narrow favours the canvas; wide favours long names and cards. HIG Split views: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/split-views

default.$description: Sidebar default width. At a 1280 px canvas the defaults leave over 700 px for focused work before dividers. Narrow favours the canvas; wide favours long names and cards. HIG Split views: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/split-views

wide.$description: Sidebar wide width. At a 1280 px canvas the defaults leave over 700 px for focused work before dividers. Narrow favours the canvas; wide favours long names and cards. HIG Split views: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/split-views

narrow.$description: Inspector narrow width. At a 1280 px canvas the defaults leave over 700 px for focused work before dividers. Narrow favours the canvas; wide favours long names and cards. HIG Split views: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/split-views

default.$description: Inspector default width. At a 1280 px canvas the defaults leave over 700 px for focused work before dividers. Narrow favours the canvas; wide favours long names and cards. HIG Split views: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/split-views

wide.$description: Inspector wide width. At a 1280 px canvas the defaults leave over 700 px for focused work before dividers. Narrow favours the canvas; wide favours long names and cards. HIG Split views: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/split-views

touch.$description: The touch target of the phone layout's controls at any window width, so `?layout=phone` on a wide window keeps it (HIG Accessibility: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility).

sticky.$description: Bars that stick while their region scrolls.

overlay.$description: Notices, the palette and its backdrop.
